messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT - P0 - Smart routing fallback policy triggered high error rate across EU<>US routing (counties: eu-west1 <-> us-east1). Pager sent to @jess and @mike. Details: https://redwood.incidents/1763456789 :rotating_light:

jess: oncall ack, looking now. seeing spike in 5xx and long tail latency in eu-west. UI shows repeated fallback attempts between eu-west1 and us-east1 for model variants.

mike: grabbing logs. looks like fallback policy is bouncing because eu-west32 pool intermittently returning model-mismatch (incompatible kv-cache) errors, then policy routes to us-east which then can't accept the request due to capacity, routing back. loop.

tess: +1. this is a policy loop. if we let it keep cycling we'll burn capacity and increase customer impact. can we force-region to break the loop temporarily?

jess: thinking: we can force-region eu-west for the affected route (route: /v1/generate?model=redwood-slim) to stop cross-region hops. will attempt manual override for enterprise tier only. tagging @ana for customer comms.

mike: caution — forcing region is fine but don't force model unless necessary. forcing model can lead to variant mismatch with cached prefixes. if you must, pick the compatible variant with same kv-cache format.

jess: executing temporary override now via ops console:```
# console action
override-routing --route "/v1/generate" --filter "customer_tier=enterprise" --force-region eu-west1 --ttl 1800
```

deploy-bot: ACTION LOG - override-routing applied by jess (session 0x7f8c). TTL 1800s.

jess: initial metrics — error rate drops ~60% in 30s. latency trending down. good so far.

ana: (support) getting first customer report from acct-44: outputs are inconsistent, some hallucinations reported for prompts that previously worked. not all customers, mostly enterprise in eu-west. forwarding example.

mike: can you paste model headers from a bad request? need to check model variant.

ana: pasted: ```
request_id: r-9b3
model: redwood-slim-v1.1-quant
server-model: redwood-slim-v1.4
kv-cache-format: v2
```

tess: aha — server is returning v1.4 but the override forced a path to an older quantized instance (v1.1-quant) for eu-west pool. kv-cache mismatch = corrupted continuations. that's the hallucination/degradation.

jess: oh no — I thought the route would pick a compatible variant. my bad, I missed the variant filter.

mike: revert force-model? but you didn't force-model, you forced region — looks like region routing selected an older pool with outdated model artifacts. need to unpin and then roll a canary to a compatible variant.

jess: rolling back region override to restore normal multi-region routing while we patch artifacts. executing:```
override-routing --route "/v1/generate" --filter "customer_tier=enterprise" --undo
```

deploy-bot: ACTION LOG - override-routing undone by jess (session 0x7f8c).

jess: after undo, errors dropped then spiked again — seems cache entries persisted. some requests still hitting the old pool due to sticky routing cookie.

mike: can we expire route cache entries? running:```
route-cache flush --route "/v1/generate" --scope eu-west1 --match "customer_tier=enterprise"
```

deploy-bot: TASK: route-cache flush started by mike.

mike: flush finished. monitoring.

ana: new customer report: some requests now 503 briefly but content quality restored for most. inbox volume down.

lee: thanks team. quick handoff — jess needs to go offline in 20m. mike, you're primary for next 2 hours. tess will stay on standby for rollback. @ana keep a customer-facing note ready: brief summary + ETA for full resolution.

jess: handing off to mike now. thanks everyone. :heart:

mike: taking over. immediate next steps: 1) confirm all eu-west pools have consistent model artifacts (v1.4) 2) add routing policy guard to prevent region-only overrides from selecting incompatible variants 3) postmortem + action items. I'll open follow-up thread.

tess: we should also add a safety check in the console UI: if operator tries to force-region, warn if model-variant compatibility not guaranteed.

ana: customer comms drafted and sent to enterprise contacts. verbatim: "We observed a routing policy issue causing intermittent degraded responses. We've mitigated by restoring routing and flushing caches — quality restored for most customers. We'll follow up with RCA and timeline."

jess: grateful this was contained. tiny ask: add a one-click rollback for overrides that also invalidates route-level sticky cookies. that would have helped.

mike: noted. creating ticket: https://redwood.tasks/RT-9821 - will include steps, owners, ETA.

lee: passing: +1 on postmortem. add a 'forced override impact matrix' to runbook.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - mitigated. severity downgraded to P2 at 1763456875.

mike: closing handoff note. patch and runbook stuff in RT-9821. will post postmortem draft in ~24h. :thumbsup:
